entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: A non-binary soldier from Penregon who became scout-captain and Kayla bin-Kroog's right hand.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Leader of Penregon, whose right hand was Myrel.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Ally of Kayla whose factory caught fire.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Source of the column of marchers led by Raddic.

entities.name: Siege of Penregon
entities.description: Siege of the city of Penregon.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war in which Myrel served.

events.summary: Myrel survives the war and returns to Penregon as scout captain.
events.quote: they did survive the war and returned to their home city to be its scout captain

events.summary: Myrel reports on the approaching Church of Tal marchers, helping Kayla and Tawnos prepare defenses.
events.quote: Myrel provided vital intelligence on the movements and composition of the approaching column of marchers from the Church of Tal

events.summary: Myrel delivers the news of the disaster after Tawnos's factory fire to Kayla.
events.quote: Myrel delivered the grim news of the disaster to Kayla

events.summary: Myrel's scouts discover greener lands to the west, and Myrel leaves with the scouts after the migration of Penregon's residents.
events.quote: discovering greener, habitable regions to the west
